visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black beret and a vibrant pink sweater, leans her face close to a branch of white plum blossoms. Her eyes are closed, capturing a moment of serenity against a soft-focus background of more flowering trees under bright natural light. (2) An expansive aerial drone shot reveals a steep mountain slope covered in a dense, white-and-pink canopy of blooming plum trees. Small dirt trails and a few dark figures of people are visible moving through the floral landscape, highlighting the scale of the plum grove. (3) The main character, now joined by a young man in a black technical jacket holding a drone controller, stands on a hillside path. They look directly into the camera, smiling and gesturing as if presenting the scenic location to the audience. (4) A group of tourists of varying ages, carrying backpacks and wearing colorful outdoor clothing, is shown from behind as they walk up a wide, asphalt mountain road. The road curves into the forest, surrounded by tall green trees and white blossoms. (5) Inside the blossom grove, the woman spins joyfully while white petals fall around her like snow. She has added white earmuffs to her outfit and is wearing a black dress. The sunlight filters through the branches, creating high-contrast cinematic lighting. (6) The scene shifts to an urban street setting where the woman is shown eating grilled tofu from a skewer. She uses chopsticks to eat a large piece of stinky tofu in a small bowl, looking satisfied and happy in the close-up shot.
